# CBS News

> > CBS News delivers breaking news, investigative journalism, and comprehensive coverage of national and international events.

CBS News is a major American news organization providing 24/7 coverage of politics, world affairs, business, health, entertainment, and technology. The site features live updates, video content, and in-depth reporting on critical issues including U.S. foreign policy, Middle East conflicts, and domestic politics.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- Trump Administration
- Iran Conflict
- Middle East Affairs
- U.S. Foreign Policy
- Military Operations
- Strait of Hormuz
- Israel Relations
- Iraq
- Kharg Island
- Live Updates
- National Security
- International Relations

- [CBS News Homepage](https://widgets-cbsn.cbsnews.com/): Breaking news, top stories, and latest headlines covering Trump, Iran, and global events with live updates
